name: Geographic Location
sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 835.5010.X221.A1.xml — the authoritative source for this segment. N405/N406 (Location Qualifier/Identifier) are marked usage="N" (Not Used) in this IG, and N408 does not exist at all in this IG's own N4 definition (it stops at N407) — this position only exists in later X12 releases, per an earlier version-mismatch finding. Corrects an earlier version of this file that included both N405/406 (added on a prior thoroughness pass) and a nonexistent N408 (inherited from an unversioned Stedi page defaulting to X12 Release 8010).

syntaxRules: E0207 (at most one of postal code / country subdivision code) and C0704 (if country subdivision code present, country code required) sourced from the same PyX12 XML's own <syntax> notes — C0605 was omitted since it references N406, a position dropped entirely as unused.
